name: Hitozuma Leotard
source:
Main character is an aerobic instructor who is about to get married. But the problem is that he loves leotards his students wear at his courses! Can he escape the temptations of a marriage and leotards?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]
